Peptides for hair loss, compared with the proven options.

Peptide Chooser editorial team. Last updated 30 Oct 2026. Every claim links to its source. Prices checked 30 Oct 2026.

Finasteride and minoxidil are the only treatments on this page the FDA has approved for hair loss, and generic finasteride starts at about $10 a month. Copper peptide serums are cosmetics: the evidence is from lab and follicle-culture studies, not from large trials in people. Injectable peptides sold for hair are not approved for any use, and we found no human evidence for hair.
